outcome: Reference values for C-reactive protein and procalcitonin
Specificity of procalcitonin to rule out infection
cohort: 189 healthy women aged 19-45 years with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies
finding: This study established reference values for procalcitonin in healthy pregnant women at term and immediately postpartum and found that procalcitonin had a high specificity for ruling out infection in this population.
mod_finding: Procalcitonin levels on day 1 postpartum differed between vaginal delivery and caesarean section, with 90% and 86.8% of results, respectively, falling below the infection decision threshold of 0.25 μg/L.
